subject: maths
concept: To Make a Mixture from Two Mixtures
question: In what ratio should a shopkeeper mix two varieties of tea priced at Rs.120 per kg and Rs.130 per kg, so that he can make a profit of 10% on selling the mixture at Rs.136.40 per kg?
solution: Given: The selling price of the mixture = Rs.136.40 per kg Profit percent = 10% Formula used: Profit percent = [(SP - CP)/ CP] × 100 Calculation ⇒ 10 = [(136.4 - CP)/ CP] × 100
